quartermaster.label: Quartermaster
quartermaster.summary: Plans settling, scavenging, trade runs and relief

envoy.label: Envoy
envoy.summary: Plans negotiations; other factions listen to them

veteran.label: Veteran
veteran.description: Has led 5 ventures: +5% odds on anything they lead

hero.label: Hero
hero.description: 3 triumphs: more of their successes become triumphs, and the crew love them (+10 loyalty)

scarred.label: Scarred
scarred.description: Wounded and came back harder: +8% on Command ventures, -5% on Diplomacy ones

shaken.label: Shaken
shaken.description: Survived a disaster: -8% odds until their next triumph

ambitious.label: Ambitious
ambitious.description: Wants power: -18 loyalty unless on the council; more likely to contest a succession

brave.label: Brave
brave.description: Leads from the front: +8% on Command ventures. As leader, pulls the faction toward Militaristic

craven.label: Craven
craven.description: Avoids a fight: -8% on Command ventures, +6% on Cunning ones

cruel.label: Cruel
cruel.description: Rules by fear: +5% on Command ventures, -10% on Diplomacy ones. As leader, everyone's loyalty -3

kind.label: Kind
kind.description: Looks after people: +8% on Diplomacy ventures, +5 loyalty. As leader, everyone's loyalty +3 and the faction leans Socialist

greedy.label: Greedy
greedy.description: Always wants more: +5% on Stewardship ventures, -5 loyalty. As leader, the faction leans Merchant

generous.label: Generous
generous.description: Shares what there is: +5% on Diplomacy ventures, +5 loyalty. As leader, the faction leans Diplomatic

conqueror.label: Conqueror
conqueror.description: Took 3 districts by force as leader: +10% on the faction's Command ventures, everyone's loyalty +3

builder.label: Builder
builder.description: Completed 5 buildings as leader: +10% on the faction's Stewardship ventures

peacemaker.label: Peacemaker
peacemaker.description: A year of peace with 2+ treaties as leader: other factions are 15% likelier to accept your proposals
